items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: Ernie Anderson, Charles Bronson had me front the Condon band, because I was the name and there was a lot of controversy.

ctx.x: I think from this point on what we should do is, instead of determining where we'll give a lot of time or a little time to that, we ought now to just the follow the career, as briefly or at whatever length you want to do, and then when we have done this and we know we have covered it all, and we bring ourselves right up to date, then perhaps you'll just digress on various thing.

You'll probably want to talk about some length about how you feel today, why are you living in England and all this sort of thing, so let's see to it that we have covered the career, so how good is your memory? I may be able to help you a bit.

All right, you want to go on more with the career. We are through with Benny Goodman. We are through -- we went into the Condon thing. I told you why I fronted the Condon band, ERnie Anderson, Charles Bronson had me front the Condon band, because I was the name and there was a lot of controversy.
